messages:
rollout-bot: Starting rollout v1.5.0 -> v1.6.0 at 3625000042. ramp: 5% -> 30% over 20m. healthchecks enabled. :rocket:
maya: noted, i'm watching dashboards. will post any SLO blips.
jason: seeing a small spike in eu-west error_rate already. p50 ok but error_rate ~2.8% on embed-service (threshold 1%).
kevin: copy. which errors? 5xx or client 4xx?
jason: mostly 5xx upstream timeouts and some grpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. sample logs: ```embed-service: ERROR dispatch failed: upstream timeout (t=1200ms)```
maya: interesting — latency on the redis kvcache also ticked up at same time. could be cache miss storm on new model sharding.
olivia: can someone run the quick query on SLO telemetry? `SELECT region, error_rate, p95_latency FROM deploy_slo WHERE service='embed-service' AND window='5m'`
jason: ran it, paste: `eu-west: error_rate=2.8%, p95=420ms; us-east: error_rate=0.4%, p95=210ms`
maya: because only eu-west got the new instances due to capacity packing. ramp -> pause?
kevin: my vote: pause ramp at 5% and pin traffic for eu-west to v1.5.0 while other regions continue. we can do targeted rollback in that region if spike persists.
olivia: agree. set `traffic-shift eu-west -> v1.5.0` and pause global ramp.
rollout-bot: Action: pause_ramp(id=rb-3625) initiated by kevin at 3625000080.
deploybot: Running traffic pin: `pin-service --service embed-service --region eu-west --version v1.5.0`
maya: +1. also create a temp canary with increased logging for embed-service in eu-west (trace request id).
jason: started tail of logs from one failing pod: ```kubectl logs pod/embed-srv-7a -n prod --since=10m | grep ERROR | head -n 30``` getting repeated upstream 504s from model-host-3.
kevin: ping infra: @olivia did we recently change egress rules or routing for that model-host group?
olivia: infra side: no routing changes. we did bump model-host auto-scaler threshold earlier today. may be underprovisioned for new model variant.
maya: can we route embed-service EU traffic to an alternate model-host pool temporarily? fallback route exists: `model-router -> pool-b`
kevin: yes, I'm flipping fallback for eu-west now. `model-router set-priority --region eu-west --primary pool-a --fallback pool-b`
rollout-bot: model-router: fallback switch queued for eu-west. will apply in 30s.
jason: after fallback applied, error_rate dropping to 0.6% in the next 2m sample. p95 back to ~230ms.
maya: good signal. keep ramp paused and monitor for 10m, then consider resuming gradual rollout with extra cache warming.
olivia: I'll open a short CR to lower autoscaler threshold for model-host pool-a and add more warmup.
kevin: also add temporary additional prefix caching on embed-service: `kv_cache.prefetch=true` for eu-west canary.
maya: filing a quick release note blurb for the rollback/pin and actions: "Paused v1.6.0 ramp in eu-west due to transient 5xx from model-hosts; pinned eu-west to v1.5.0; applied model-router fallback and cache-prefetch; infra adjusting autoscaler."
jason: if error_rate climbs back above 1% in eu-west after fallback, we should rollback globally.
olivia: noted. i'll set an alert: `if error_rate(region=eu-west)>1% for 3m -> open incident, escalate to SRE`
rollout-bot: Rollout state: PAUSED at 5% (eu-west pinned to v1.5.0). Next check at 3625000120. :white_check_mark:
